display.title: The Nine Days: Ahavas Yisroel Instead of Baseless Hatred
display.summary_short: As the month of Av begins, Uncle Yossi explains that the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed because of baseless hatred, and that loving every Jew will bring Moshiach.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show for the start of the month of Av. Uncle Yossi asks what caused the sad events we remember in this month, above all the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash in Yerushalayim, and what we can do so they never happen again. Our Sages teach that the main cause was sinas chinam, baseless hatred, which Hashem despises. He brings the Alter Rebbe's parable: nothing pleases parents more than seeing their children love each other and live in peace, and since we are all Hashem's children, nothing pleases Hashem more than Ahavas Yisroel. By loving every Jew we correct the mistakes of the past and pave the way for Moshiach, who will gather us all back to Eretz Yisroel.
display.lesson: Baseless hatred destroyed the Beis HaMikdash; loving every Jew will rebuild it and bring Moshiach.
